description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing Git worktrees, including functions for retrieving, validating, repairing, and linking worktrees, as well as handling their metadata and relationships.

classes.name: worktree
classes.description: Represents a Git worktree, including its repository association, path, identifier, HEAD reference, lock and prune reasons, and status flags.

methods.name: get_worktrees
methods.description: Retrieves all linked worktrees, with the primary first.

methods.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
methods.description: Retrieves worktrees without reading the HEAD, useful for inconsistent refdb states.

methods.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
methods.description: Checks if submodules use worktrees at the given path.

methods.name: get_worktree_git_dir
methods.description: Returns the git directory of a specified worktree.

methods.name: find_worktree
methods.description: Finds a worktree based on a user-supplied argument, which can be a pathname or shorthand.

methods.name: get_linked_worktree
methods.description: Looks up a linked worktree by its ID.

methods.name: find_worktree_by_path
methods.description: Finds a worktree by its filesystem path.

methods.name: is_main_worktree
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is the main one.

methods.name: worktree_lock_reason
methods.description: Returns the lock reason string for a worktree.

methods.name: worktree_prune_reason
methods.description: Returns the prune reason string for a worktree, considering expiration.

methods.name: should_prune_worktree
methods.description: Determines if a worktree should be pruned, providing the reason.

methods.name: validate_worktree
methods.description: Validates the integrity of a worktree, returning zero if OK.

methods.name: update_worktree_location
methods.description: Updates the git directory location of a worktree.

methods.name: repair_worktrees
methods.description: Repairs linked worktrees, invoking a callback for each repair or error.

methods.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repairs worktrees after the git directory has been moved.

methods.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repairs a specific worktree after its git directory has been moved.

methods.name: repair_worktree_at_path
methods.description: Repairs administrative files for a worktree at a given path.

methods.name: free_worktree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a worktree.

methods.name: free_worktrees
methods.description: Frees memory for an array of worktrees.

methods.name: find_shared_symref
methods.description: Finds a worktree sharing a symbolic ref.

methods.name: is_shared_symref
methods.description: Checks if a symref points to a ref in a worktree.

methods.name: other_head_refs
methods.description: Iterates over HEAD refs in all worktrees except one.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
methods.description: Checks if a worktree is currently bisecting.

methods.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
methods.description: Generates a refname for a worktree.

methods.name: init_worktree_config
methods.description: Enables worktree configuration, adjusting git config files.

methods.name: write_worktree_linking_files
methods.description: Creates linking files (.git and gitdir) for a worktree.
